opt.description: Placement initialization, continuous optimization and legalization settings

case_dir.description: Case input directory; supports {case}; relative to project root

result_dir.description: Placement output directory; supports {case}, {mode}, {timestamp}; relative to project root

ilp_solver.description: ILP solver used. grb/gurobi with gurobipy is recommended; pulp is not guaranteed to match strict legal-placement behavior

initialization_time_limit_s.description: Time limit in seconds for each initialization ILP attempt before continuous optimization (CBC/Gurobi)

legalization_time_limit_s.description: Time limit in seconds for each final legalization ILP attempt (CBC/Gurobi), shared by the initial solve and the displacement-only fallback; at most two attempts

dis_bet_chips.description: Minimum edge-to-edge spacing between chiplets, typically <0.2mm, unit: um

num_bins_x.description: Number of bins in horizontal direction; computed by internal heuristic if not specified

num_bins_y.description: Number of bins in vertical direction; computed by internal heuristic if not specified

stop_overflow.description: Stopping criteria, consider stop when the overflow reaches to a ratio

plot_freq.description: Plot and print solution frequency, <0 is not

ref_hpwl.description: Reference HPWL used for updating density weight

density_weight_lower_ratio.description: Lower bound ratio used for updating density weight

density_weight_upper_ratio.description: Upper bound ratio used for updating density weight

eta.description: Coefficient in the exp relation of theta

num_threads.description: CPU threads for PyTorch and ILP solvers

iteration.description: Outer iterations for the placement stage

learning_rate.description: Placement learning rates: [position, angle]; case files override the default

learning_rate_decay.description: Multiplier for placement learning rates per outer iteration

optimizer.description: Placement optimizer: cgm, adam, sgd, sgd_momentum or sgd_nesterov

density_weight_iterations.description: Weight-level iterations per outer placement iteration

thermal.description: Thermal-model training, thermal objectives and ATSim evaluation settings

num_threads.description: Parallel core count for ATSim thermal simulations, including training label generation; independent of opt.num_threads

thermal_solver.description: ATSim executable path, relative to project root; sim.config.template, structure.xml.template and material.config.template must be beside the executable

num_grid_x.description: Number of chip-midplane temperature samples and ATSim grid columns in the x direction

num_grid_y.description: Number of chip-midplane temperature samples and ATSim grid rows in the y direction

thermal_convection_resistance.description: Total heatsink-to-ambient convection resistance in K/W; ATSim uses htc_top = 1 / (resistance * heatsink top area)

thermal_model.description: Saved ATSim chip-midplane thermal model checkpoint, relative to project root; {case} is expanded

training_samples.description: Number of independently simulated training layouts

training_test_samples.description: Number of held-out ATSim layouts (not used for fitting)

training_seed.description: Seed for random layout sampling and thermal-model fitting

training_lr_decay_step.description: StepLR learning-rate decay interval in updates

training_lr_decay_gamma.description: StepLR learning-rate multiplier per decay interval

training_dataset.description: Optional saved dataset path; null generates fresh ATSim labels

training_result_dir.description: Training dataset, simulation logs and report directory; supports {case} and {timestamp}

training_ilp_solver.description: Layout sampling solver: pulp or grb; null inherits opt.ilp_solver

training_sampling_time_limit_s.description: Time limit for each layout sampling ILP, in seconds

simulation_result_dir.description: Output directory for run_thermal_evaluation.py; supports {case} and {timestamp}

simulation_timeout_s.description: Timeout for each ATSim call, including training labels, in seconds

temp_threshold.description: Chip-midplane target temperature in Celsius used by the thermal penalty (not a hard upper bound)

temp_weight_init.description: Initial thermal penalty weight coefficient before gradient normalization during placement
